profile.title: Web & Mobile App Developer
profile.tagline: Architecting high-velocity Web Applications, Native Android Apps & Resilient Cloud Backends. Transforming complex product requirements into seamless, pixel-perfect digital experiences.
profile.bio: I am a dedicated Full-Stack Web and Native Android Application Developer with over 4 years of proven engineering experience. My technical journey centers on writing clean, scalable, and well-tested code that bridges fluid user experiences with robust cloud backends. From high-throughput real-time gaming engines to scalable enterprise administrative platforms and reactive mobile applications, I craft software that performs under load and scales effortlessly.
